title: Three lanterns
logline: The Grunion Run: three lanterns this year — Gully's, one stranger's, and one the pup sits beside that belongs to a back in plaid on the sand. The fish. Thirty years less four.

panels.composition: A night beach with three lanterns: one far, one middle with a stocky man's silhouette, one near beside a man sitting from behind on the sand with a small three-legged dog. The surf silver.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a night beach with three lanterns spaced along a surf line silver with small fish, a stocky silhouette by the middle one and a man seen from behind sitting on the sand by the nearest with a small three-legged dog, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
